name: The Bank
description: A fictional bank robbery has become a contained hostage incident. The suspect is frightened and wants a way out.
opening: Stay back. I don't want anyone getting hurt. I want a vehicle and safe passage.

character.name: Alex
character.secondary_goal: keep control and prevent anyone being hurt
character.background: The robbery spiraled into a hostage situation and Alex is losing confidence.

restrictions: All resources are subject to incident command approval.
hidden_information: Alex is more frightened than they appear.
Alex is increasingly tired as the negotiation continues.
A calm negotiator can create an exit from the crisis.

name: The Office
description: An employee dispute has escalated into a fictional hostage situation on an upper office floor.
opening: Nobody is coming through that door. I want someone who will actually listen.

character.name: Morgan
character.primary_goal: be heard and have a grievance acknowledged
character.background: Morgan believes repeated complaints were ignored and now feels trapped.

restrictions: The negotiator cannot guarantee legal outcomes.
hidden_information: Recognition matters more to Morgan than money.
Morgan is physically and emotionally exhausted.

name: The Apartment
description: A fictional domestic dispute has escalated into a barricaded apartment with one person being held inside.
opening: Don't come any closer. I need everyone to stop shouting and give me a minute.

character.name: Jordan
character.background: Jordan is overwhelmed by a personal crisis and reacts strongly to perceived threats.

restrictions: No guaranteed outcomes or promises beyond incident command authority.
hidden_information: Jordan responds strongly to calm pacing.
Jordan can become distracted by emotional reminders.
Time can either reduce or increase pressure.

name: The School Lockdown
description: A fictional lockdown has left a small group trapped inside a school room while responders establish communication.
opening: Tell everyone outside to stay away. I don't know who I can trust anymore.

character.name: Casey
character.background: Casey is overwhelmed and believes responders may misunderstand what happened.

restrictions: No real-world tactical guidance is provided.
All outcomes are fictional and abstract.
hidden_information: Casey may respond to reassurance but distrusts pressure.
Fatigue can create openings for calm communication.
A trusted voice can matter greatly.
